title: VTN Relay — Deliver — payload
description: A parent network's delivery of a broadcast envelope to this network's group for a role. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

role.description: This network's local role whose network group the delivery addresses.

Response.title: VTN Relay — Deliver — response payload
Response.description: What happened to the message here, and the receipts of this network's own deliveries.

status.description: `delivered`: accepted and relayed. `duplicate`: seen before; nothing relayed.

relayed.description: One receipt per group this network delivered to; empty for a duplicate.
